title: FIRST LOVE: Tender Romantic BGM (original score)
description:
And then the heart knew. A tender, aching first-love theme: a soft bansuri flute and warm Indian-style violins over a gentle tabla pulse, for the quiet moments when love is new and a little scary.

For fans of emotional love BGM, sad-romantic scenes, flute themes and South Indian film music. Headphones on.

Music: First Love, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
